gateway_run_config:
# LiteLLM config for the CVE-2026-59822 regression gate (FIXED versions only).
#
# A single NON-oauth2 MCP server (auth_type: none). On a FIXED LiteLLM
# (>= 1.84.0, PR #26463) the MCP endpoint's anonymous fallback runs only when
# EVERY target server is auth_type=oauth2; for a non-oauth2 server a request
# whose bearer fails LiteLLM key validation is rejected (the auth error is
# re-raised), never admitted with an anonymous session. This config exercises
# that path: invalid / garbage / forged / absent bearer -> no session; a valid
# LiteLLM key (Authorization: Bearer <master key>) -> session established.
#
# Loopback only; the driver (integration/xid10_litellm_cve59822_gate.py)
# substitutes http://127.0.0.1:4553/mcp into a temp copy and supplies the master key via
# the environment (a throwaway generated per run). This tests PATCHED behaviour
# only -- no affected (< 1.84.0) version is ever installed or run.
model_list: []
litellm_settings:
  telemetry: false
general_settings:
  master_key: os.environ/LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
mcp_servers:
  notes:
    url: http://127.0.0.1:4553/mcp
    transport: http
    # Non-oauth2 (auth_type: none): the gateway requires a valid LiteLLM
    # admission credential; it does NOT fall back to an anonymous session when
    # the bearer cannot be validated.
    auth_type: none
